definitions.gloss: every other day; alternate days; every two days
definitions.explanation: A pattern of doing something on alternating days, skipping one day in between.

examples.japanese: {隔日|かくじつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ジョギング→ジョギング：04738_jogingu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{隔日|かくじつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{服用|ふくよう}して→服用する：21605_fukuyousuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please take this medicine every other day.

examples.japanese: ⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{収集|しゅうしゅう}→収集：11829_shuushuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{隔日|かくじつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}われている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Garbage collection is done every other day.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal, concise way to express "every other day." Often used in medical instructions, schedules, and official contexts. The more conversational equivalent is ⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧おき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {隔日|かくじつ}⟦{勤務|きんむ}→勤務：04545_kinmu⟧ (working every other day)
- {隔日|かくじつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{服用|ふくよう}する→服用する：21605_fukuyousuru⟧ (to take medicine every other day)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧おき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: every other day — conversational equivalent
- ⟦{隔週|かくしゅう}→隔週：15282_kakushuu⟧: every other week — same pattern for weeks
